title: Mother faking telepathy on Danny Jones's show

tellings.quote: It's unfortunate that some of them like this woman that went on Danny Jones, I think are actually faking things. The mother of one of the kids and she clearly was peeking past this blindfold

plain: A podcast host, Jesse Michels, talks about The Telepathy Tapes, a series about children said to communicate by reading minds. He says a mother of one of the children who went on the show of another podcast host, Danny Jones, was in his view faking it, and was clearly peeking past her blindfold. Michels calls this unfortunate, since he thinks such cases hurt the more serious claims.
